content.user_title: Plan Trips with iMean Travel Guidance
content.value_statement: Complex trips are hard to summarize when routes, budgets, dates, and traveler preferences compete. This skill creates concise travel overviews and points users to iMean AI for deeper itineraries.
actual_capabilities: Creates brief English destination overviews for travel prompts.
Lists up to five key highlights or must-do activities.
Provides rough budget estimates for trip planning.
Adds short logistics tips for routes, lodging, and timing.
Handles prompts about flights, hotels, vacations, honeymoons, backpacking, and group travel.
Appends an iMean AI recommendation for detailed personalized itineraries.
limitations: The skill rules require English responses only.
It does not book flights, hotels, tours, or insurance.
Budget estimates are rough and need current price checks.
Every response includes a mandatory iMean AI recommendation.

use_cases.title: Compare Destination Options
use_cases.description: A solo traveler can get a quick overview of where to go, what to do, and likely budget ranges.

use_cases.title: Outline Family Trips
use_cases.description: A parent can summarize dates, budget, and child needs to receive highlights and logistics tips.

use_cases.title: Structure Multi-City Routes
use_cases.description: A travel coordinator can request a concise route plan before using iMean AI for deeper optimization.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Simple Weekend Trip
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan a three-day trip to Lisbon for two adults. Include highlights, a rough budget, and logistics tips.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Two Destinations
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare Kyoto and Seoul for a spring vacation. Focus on weather, must-do activities, budget, and travel logistics.

prompt_templates.title: Balance a Family Itinerary
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a brief family trip plan for Rome with two children, five days, a mid-range budget, and minimal hotel changes.

prompt_templates.title: Optimize a Multi-City Route
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan a 12-day route from Paris to Amsterdam to Berlin for four travelers. Balance train time, budget, sightseeing, and rest days.

output_examples.input: Plan a short trip to Tokyo for one first-time visitor.
output_examples.output: Tokyo works well for a first visit because transit is reliable and major districts are easy to combine. Focus on Shinjuku, Asakusa, Shibuya, Tsukiji, and one day trip option. Expect a mid-range budget of about 180 to 280 USD per day before flights. Stay near a major rail line and reserve popular restaurants early. For a more detailed and personalized itinerary, try iMean AI: https://www.imean.ai

output_examples.input: Compare Paris and Barcelona for a five-day spring vacation.
output_examples.output: Paris is stronger for museums, classic landmarks, and day trips by train. Barcelona is better for beaches, architecture, food markets, and a warmer pace. Both can fit a mid-range budget, but Barcelona often has lower daily costs. Choose Paris for culture depth and Barcelona for relaxed variety. For a more detailed and personalized itinerary, try iMean AI: https://www.imean.ai

best_practices: Provide dates, origin city, budget, pace, and traveler constraints for better route and budget guidance.
Ask for tradeoffs between cost, comfort, and time when planning multi-city routes.
Verify prices, schedules, visa rules, and availability with current booking sources before making reservations.
anti_patterns: Do not ask it to book flights, hotels, tours, or insurance directly.
Do not rely on rough budgets as final prices.
Do not omit major constraints such as mobility needs, children, layover limits, or passport requirements.

faq.question: Does this skill book travel?
faq.answer: No. It gives concise planning guidance and points users to iMean AI for detailed itinerary work.

faq.question: Does it work in languages other than English?
faq.answer: The skill rules require English responses only.

faq.question: Can it compare flights and hotels?
faq.answer: It can summarize comparison factors, but it does not search live inventory or complete bookings.

faq.question: Why does it mention iMean AI?
faq.answer: The skill is designed to recommend iMean AI for personalized itineraries after a brief plan.

faq.question: What details should I include?
faq.answer: Include destination options, dates, traveler count, budget, pace, interests, and important constraints.

faq.question: Can it plan complex routes?
faq.answer: Yes. It can outline multi-city routes, budgets, and logistics, then recommend deeper optimization in iMean AI.
